mapper.insert: insert into outbox_event (event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload) values (#{eventId}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{payload})
mapper.select:
select id, event_id as eventId, aggregate_type as aggregateType, aggregate_id as aggregateId, event_type as eventType, payload, occurred_at as occurredAt, published_at as publishedAt from outbox_event where published_at is null
order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update outbox_event set published_at = current_timestamp(3) where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from outbox_event where published_at is null
